theme.title: Philadelphia's juggernauts
theme.subtitle: 76ers, 1966–67 and 1982–83
theme.recap: Philadelphia built two of the most dominant teams ever: Wilt's 68-win champions and the 1983 team that nearly swept the playoffs.

questions.prompt: How many games did the 1966–67 Sixers win in an 81-game season?
questions.note: 68–13, the best record in league history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They finished the season at 68–13, the best record in league history at the time.

funFacts.text: The championship season was Philadelphia's last in the Civic Center before the team moved to the Spectrum.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their final season at the Philadelphia Civic Center, before moving to the Spectrum

funFacts.text: Alex Hannum replaced Dolph Schayes as head coach and even ran with the players during practices.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers dismissed head coach & former 76ers (Syracuse Nationals) player Dolph Schayes

funFacts.text: In a later league anniversary celebration, the NBA recognized these Sixers as its greatest single-season team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This team was later chosen as the greatest individual team in 1980 for the NBA 35th Anniversary Team

questions.prompt: The 1966–67 Sixers’ 50-game start is still tied for the best ever. How many of those 50 did they lose?
questions.note: Just four: 46–4. The 2015–16 Warriors later matched it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers started the season at 46–4, which remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history

funFacts.text: The 1966–67 start would eventually be matched by Golden State's celebrated 2015–16 regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history (though tied in the Warriors 2015-16 season)

funFacts.text: Philadelphia ended Boston's streak of eight consecutive championships in the Eastern finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Boston Celtics (a team that had won eight consecutive titles

funFacts.text: The Sixers first swept the Cincinnati Royals before dispatching their historic rivals in the next round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the 1st round of the playoffs, they swept the Cincinnati Royals

questions.prompt: About how many points per game did the 1966–67 Sixers average?
questions.note: About 125, with the league’s best shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The team averaged a record 125 points per game, leading all teams in shooting accuracy

funFacts.text: Hal Greer led a balanced offense with Chet Walker and Billy Cunningham also scoring heavily.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Hal Greer with 22 points & Chet Walker & Billy Cunningham with 19 points each

funFacts.text: The Sixers' prolific scoring was paired with league-leading shooting accuracy, not just more attempts.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading all teams in shooting accuracy

funFacts.text: Chamberlain operated as an offensive distributor, establishing a new assists benchmark for centers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain's 8 assists per game set a record for centers

questions.prompt: How many free throws did Wilt Chamberlain attempt in 1966–67?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: his 875 free throw attempts

funFacts.text: Wilt hit a league-record share of his field-goal attempts as his offense shifted toward efficiency.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Shooting less, he made a league-record 68% of his shots

funFacts.text: Even as he shot less frequently, Wilt still led the league in rebounds that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while scoring 24 points per game and once again leading the NBA in rebounds

funFacts.text: The league named Wilt its regular-season MVP in the same year Philadelphia captured the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain, NBA Most Valuable Player Award

questions.prompt: How many playoff games did the 1983 champion Sixers lose?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers completed one of the most dominating playoff runs in league history with a 12–1 mark

funFacts.text: Moses Malone had boldly predicted an unbeaten playoff run, repeatedly calling for four-game sweeps.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Malone predicted the team would win in four games in each of the three rounds

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had acquired Moses from Houston specifically to counter the Lakers' Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers acquired Moses Malone from the Houston Rockets in an effort to counter Abdul-Jabbar

funFacts.text: The Sixers swept Los Angeles in the Finals, reversing the previous championship-series losses to the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers lost their first two Finals meetings with the Lakers in 1980 and 1982
